questions.question: At the elbow, the radial collateral ligament mainly prevents excessive ______ and the ulnar collateral ligament mainly prevents excessive ______.
questions.explanation: The lateral (radial) collateral ligament resists varus stress and the medial (ulnar) collateral ligament resists valgus stress.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The ligament of the wrist that prevents excessive hyperextension is the:
questions.explanation: The palmar radiocarpal ligaments become taut in extension.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The ligament of the wrist that prevents excessive flexion is the:
questions.explanation: The dorsal radiocarpal ligament limits flexion.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The ligament of the wrist that limits excessive ulnar deviation is the:
questions.explanation: The radial collateral ligament becomes taut in ulnar deviation.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The ligament that most limits excessive extension of the hip is the:
questions.explanation: The iliofemoral (Y) ligament is taut in extension and prevents anterior tilt of the pelvis in standing.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The ligament of the hip that mainly limits excessive abduction and extension is the:
questions.explanation: The pubofemoral ligament is taut in abduction and extension, preventing excessive abduction.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The ligament that prevents anterior displacement of the tibia on the femur is the:
questions.explanation: The ACL is the primary restraint to anterior tibial translation.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The ligament that prevents posterior displacement of the tibia on the femur is the:
questions.explanation: The PCL is the primary restraint to posterior tibial translation.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The ligament of the knee that limits valgus force is the:
questions.explanation: The MCL resists valgus (abduction) stress; the LCL resists varus.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The ligament of the knee that limits varus force is the:
questions.explanation: The LCL resists varus (adduction) stress at the knee.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The deltoid ligament of the ankle limits excessive talar:
questions.explanation: The medial (deltoid) ligament resists eversion; the lateral ligaments resist inversion.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The prosencephalon (forebrain) consists of the:
questions.explanation: The forebrain gives the cerebral hemispheres (telencephalon) and the diencephalon.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The mesencephalon (midbrain) consists of the:
questions.explanation: The midbrain comprises the tectum (dorsal) and the tegmentum.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The rhombencephalon (hindbrain) consists of the:
questions.explanation: The hindbrain gives rise to the pons and cerebellum (metencephalon) and the medulla (myelencephalon).
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the diencephalon?
questions.explanation: The diencephalon includes the thalamus, hypothalamus, epithalamus and subthalamus; the pons is in the brainstem.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the brainstem?
questions.explanation: The brainstem is the midbrain, pons and medulla oblongata.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The spinal cord has how many cervical segments?
questions.explanation: There are 8 cervical spinal segments but 7 cervical vertebrae.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Pain and temperature sensations are carried by the:
questions.explanation: The lateral spinothalamic tract carries pain and temperature.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Crude touch is carried by the:
questions.explanation: The anterior spinothalamic tract carries crude touch and pressure.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Proprioception, vibration sense and tactile discrimination are carried by the:
questions.explanation: The fasciculus gracilis and cuneatus carry fine touch and joint position.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Voluntary motor control is the function of the:
questions.explanation: The corticospinal (pyramidal) tract mediates voluntary skilled movements.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Which descending tract controls postural reflexes and muscle tone?
questions.explanation: The vestibulospinal tract adjusts posture and facilitates extensor tone.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Head turning in response to visual stimuli is mediated by the:
questions.explanation: The tectospinal tract carries visual reflex information to cervical motor neurons.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Facilitation of extensor tone against gravity is a function of the:
questions.explanation: The lateral vestibulospinal tract excites extensor motor neurons for upright posture.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The lateral ventricle communicates with the third ventricle through the:
questions.explanation: The interventricular foramen (of Monro) connects the lateral and third ventricles.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: CSF leaves the fourth ventricle into the subarachnoid space through the:
questions.explanation: The median aperture (Magendie) and lateral apertures (Luschka) drain the fourth ventricle.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The brain forms about ______ percent of body weight.
questions.explanation: The adult brain is about 1.4 kg, roughly 2 percent of body weight.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: In an adult the spinal cord terminates at the level of:
questions.explanation: The conus medullaris lies at about L1-L2.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The outermost layer of the meninges is the:
questions.explanation: From outside inwards: dura, arachnoid, pia.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The innermost layer of the meninges, closely applied to the brain, is the:
questions.explanation: The pia mater adheres to the brain surface and follows the sulci.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The apex of the heart lies at the level of the ______ intercostal space.
questions.explanation: The apex beat is in the left 5th intercostal space in the mid-clavicular line.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Compared with the left ventricle, the walls of the right ventricle are:
questions.explanation: The RV pumps against low pulmonary resistance so its wall is thin.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The right atrioventricular valve of the heart is the:
questions.explanation: The tricuspid valve lies between the right atrium and right ventricle.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The left atrioventricular valve of the heart is the:
questions.explanation: The mitral (bicuspid) valve lies between the left atrium and left ventricle.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The semilunar valve that prevents backflow of blood into the right ventricle is the:
questions.explanation: The pulmonary valve guards the outflow of the right ventricle.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The semilunar valve that prevents backflow of blood into the left ventricle is the:
questions.explanation: The aortic valve guards the outflow of the left ventricle.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The right coronary artery supplies all of the following EXCEPT the:

options.D: Anterior portion of the interventricular septum

questions.explanation: The anterior interventricular septum is supplied by the left anterior descending artery.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The left anterior descending artery supplies the:

options.D: Anterior portion of the interventricular septum

questions.explanation: The LAD supplies the anterior LV wall and the anterior two-thirds of the septum.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The left atrium and the posterior, lateral, anterior and inferior walls of the left ventricle are supplied mainly by the:

options.D: Circumflex artery of the left coronary artery

questions.explanation: The circumflex branch supplies the left atrium and lateral/posterior left ventricle.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Pump handle movement of the ribs primarily occurs at the:
questions.explanation: Upper ribs (2-6) move up and forward like a pump handle, increasing the anteroposterior diameter.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Which layer of the pleura is sensitive to pain?
questions.explanation: The parietal pleura has somatic pain innervation; the visceral pleura has none.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Which layer of the pleura is insensitive to pain?
questions.explanation: The visceral pleura is supplied by autonomic fibres and is pain-insensitive.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The trachea extends from the level of:
questions.explanation: The trachea begins at the lower border of the cricoid cartilage (C6) and ends at T4-T5.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The airways divide about ______ times between the trachea and the alveoli.
questions.explanation: The airways undergo about 23 generations of dichotomous branching.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: There are ______ bronchopulmonary segments in the right lung and ______ in the left lung.
questions.explanation: The right lung has 10 segments; the left has 8 because some segments are combined.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The stratum corneum of the epidermis consists of:
questions.explanation: The stratum corneum is the keratinised, dead outer layer.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Collagen and elastic fibres are the main constituents of the:
questions.explanation: The dermis gives the skin its strength and elasticity.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: The subcutaneous tissue (hypodermis) is composed mainly of:
questions.explanation: The hypodermis stores fat and insulates the body.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of the levator ani?
questions.explanation: Levator ani = pubococcygeus, puborectalis and iliococcygeus; coccygeus lies alongside it.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Which of the following pelvic muscles is NOT superficial?
questions.explanation: The pelvic diaphragm is the deep muscle layer.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: Which of the following muscles constitute the pelvic diaphragm?
questions.explanation: The pelvic diaphragm is levator ani plus coccygeus.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams

questions.question: About 70% of the pelvic floor muscles are made up of:
questions.explanation: The pelvic floor has a high proportion of slow-twitch fibres for continuous tone.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
